# Screening Results

> Topic: EEG neurofeedback for mild cognitive impairment (MCI)
> Papers screened: 42
> Date: 2026-10-26
> Threshold: composite >= 3.5

## Screening Criteria

### Inclusion
- Participants are adults with MCI (amnestic or non-amnestic) or prodromal Alzheimer's disease, or mixed samples reporting MCI subgroup results
- Intervention is EEG-based neurofeedback training (any frequency-band, connectivity, or source-localized protocol)
- Reports cognitive outcomes (global cognition, memory, executive function, attention) and/or EEG biomarker outcomes
- Empirical study (RCT, controlled or single-arm trial, feasibility study) or systematic review/meta-analysis
- Published 2019-2026 with an available abstract

### Exclusion
- Population without cognitive impairment (healthy young adults, ADHD, stroke, ALS, MS) unless results are directly transferable to MCI
- Non-EEG neurofeedback only (fMRI or fNIRS) or non-neurofeedback interventions (pure cognitive training, tDCS/TMS)
- Purely diagnostic or classification EEG studies with no training intervention
- Animal studies, editorials, commentaries, or conference abstracts without data
- No abstract and an ambiguous title
